name: Darkhound Blood
summary: In Tirisfal's fields and forests, tainted darkhounds yield Darkhound Blood, a bodily fluid. The Royal Apothecary Society gathers it as an early reagent for experiments to engineer a lethal new plague.

sections.title: Fuel for the New Plague
sections.body:
Under Lady Sylvanas Windrunner, the Royal Apothecary Society seeks a virulent contagion that can wipe out Arthas and his Scourge. Apothecary Johaan is stationed in Brill. He theorizes that local beasts, corrupted by dark energies and resilient to the surrounding decay, possess unusual biological properties.

By distilling wild darkhound blood, Johaan hopes to uncover compounds that can resist or spread virulent necrotic strains.

faq.q: What is Darkhound Blood used for?
faq.answer: Apothecary Johaan in Brill uses Darkhound Blood as an early reagent in the Royal Apothecary Society's research to concoct a new plague deadlier than anything Azeroth has ever seen.
Darkhound Blood comes from the cursed, ravenous, and decrepit darkhounds wandering Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Why are darkhounds targeted for plague research?
faq.answer: Apothecary Johaan theorizes that the blood of beasts acclimated to Tirisfal's corrupted lands may hold the biological secrets needed to synthesize an unstoppable contagion.

angles.text: Harvesting reagents like Darkhound Blood is essential work for the Forsaken. It helps Lady Sylvanas and the Royal Apothecary Society forge their ultimate weapon against the Scourge.
In Brill, the Royal Apothecary Society pursues dark experiments whose toxic potential few beyond the Forsaken inner circle fully grasp.
